headline: Where Does Oil Go Next After the Hormuz Crisis?
summary: Samantha Dart, Co-Head of Global Commodities Research at Goldman Sachs, discusses how oil prices may develop if the conflict in the Strait of Hormuz continues to escalate, and warns that a supply glut may pose a challenge even if the supply interruptions are resolved.
